mapper.select: SELECT #{employeeId} AS evaluator_id, p.employee_id, p.title, p.start_date, p.end_date, DATE(p.created_at) AS created_at, p.work_item, p.achievement_rate, p.work_detail FROM performance p WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation e WHERE e.employee_id = p.employee_id AND e.evaluator_id = #{employeeId} ) AND p.status = 'WAITING' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC
